source_note: Labour Code of the Republic of Armenia ՀՕ-124-Ն (arlis.am redaction 23.12.2022-06.04.2023; owner confirmed current 22 Nov 2026). Quotes and article reading in docs/legal/PRE_REVIEW.md. Lawyer must confirm.
basis: Art. 95(2.1): when a fixed-term contract is extended, or a second contract is concluded with the same employee for the same work and the break does not exceed one month, «աշխատանքային պայմանագիրը համարվում է կնքված անորոշ ժամկետով» (deemed indefinite). Does not apply to cases under Art. 95(1) and 95(3). Official checklist N 5.1 question 11.

title.hy: Որոշակի ժամկետով պայմանագիրը կնքվել է նախորդի ավարտից մեկ ամսվա ընթացքում՝ կարող է համարվել անորոշ ժամկետով
title.ru: Срочный договор заключён в течение месяца после предыдущего: может считаться бессрочным
title.en: Fixed-term contract follows the previous one within a month: may be deemed indefinite

edge_cases: Fires on the later contract when an earlier fixed-term contract with this employer ended at most one month before its start (or overlaps it) and no Art. 95 ground is recorded.
A recorded ground may fall under Art. 95(1) or 95(3), where the rule does not apply, so the rule stays quiet then; the lawyer should decide.
'Same work' is not stored: a different job after a short break is not distinguished.
Extension by amendment (same contract, later end date) is not tracked as a separate contract.
